name: Showcase
description: Every block shape and widget a plugin can draw, on one page, with the source next to it. Install it, open any film or series, and follow the link: you get a rotating hero, big figures, bars, a two-column split, and the same tiles drawn as posters, wide cards, squares and circles. It asks for no permissions at all. minHostVersion is 0.65.0 because an older server silently drops a block type it does not know: keep that number equal to the release that carries the D177 vocabulary, and raise it in the same commit as any newer shape.
author: Multipass
